requests.purpose: Locate exact launcher own persistent icon cache/database without deletion or broad traversal; preserve each absence independently

requests.shell:
for f in /data/service/el1/public/bms/bundle_resources/bundleResource.db /data/service/el1/public/bms/bundle_resources/bundleResource_slave.db; do printf '
DATABASE=%s
' "$f"; stat -c '%d:%i %u:%g %a' "$f"; /bin/sqlite3 -readonly -json "$f" "SELECT NAME,LABEL,length(ICON) AS icon_length,length(FOREGROUND) AS foreground_length,length(BACKGROUND) AS background_length FROM bundleResource WHERE NAME IN ('app.varlorg.unote','app.varlorg.unote/entry/app.varlorg.unote.NoteMain','com.alxgnon.postwriter','com.alxgnon.postwriter/entry/com.alxgnon.postwriter.MainActivity','org.tasks','org.tasks/entry/com.todoroo.astrid.activity.TaskListActivity');"; done; printf '
REMOTE_RC=%s
' "$?"
requests.purpose: Distinguish changed master from unchanged NativeRdb slave and stale BACKGROUND values; no writes
Root fills actual current foundation PID from existing process evidence, then compares both candidate paths/dev:inode through its /proc/PID/root; no guessed PID

hypotheses_not_findings: Launcher persistent grid/icon cache holds old source
BMS getter reads a different namespace database/replica or in-memory resource cache
Launcher falls back to iconId/resourcePath entry.hap (still original placeholder), rather than updated resource URI
